headline: A calm day at United's hubs, with flights running normally.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 85% on time or better, meaning within 30 minutes of schedule. No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub.
The 405 United flights in the air are 37% fewer than usual for this time of day, which is in line with a lighter schedule today.
The FAA's operations plan lists one possible program for later, a ground stop for flights into Boston until 7:30 PM ET, and it is not in effect.
